label: dry_run
implementation_notes: ContextKnapsack clips negative pairwise similarity to zero inside the frozen core; relevance is used raw, as the protocol requires.
CBC is invoked through PULP_CBC_CMD without a threads argument, which is CBC's single-threaded default; OMP_NUM_THREADS is pinned to 1.
W_pool is computed on the post-exclusion pool; zero-token sentences contribute nothing to the sum, so the value is identical either way.
